title: How Much Determinism Can Fine-Tuning Buy? Margin Regularisation Against Batch-Induced Token Flips
abstract: arXiv:2611.19135v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Greedy decoding at zero temperature is widely assumed to be deterministic, although the exact same prompt may yield different tokens depending on the number of other prompts sharing the batch for inference. The currently available solutions operate during inference, trading determinism for throughput. Can we train a model in such a way that fewer decoding steps would be susceptible? We characterize the perturbation empirically across six model families and three numerical precisions and observe two empirical facts about the measurement: the perturbation depends exactly on the representable precision (8.00x for bfloat16 vs float16, 8192.0x for float16 vs float32, in line with predictions based on mantissa bits) and the batch invariance happens accidentally at certain tensor shapes, allowing a practitioner to achieve zero nondeterminism merely by setting the sequence length. translated_title: 微调能换来多少确定性？针对批次引发词元翻转的间隔正则化方法
translated_abstract: 零温度下的贪心解码被广泛认为是确定性的，然而完全相同的提示词，可能因推理时共享批次的其他提示词数量不同而产生不同的词元。目前现有的解决方案都是在推理阶段运行的，需要以吞吐量换取确定性。我们能否通过某种训练方式，使更少的解码步骤受到这种扰动的影响？我们在六个模型系列和三种数值精度下对该扰动进行了实证刻画，并观察到关于这一度量的两个经验事实：其一，扰动幅度完全取决于可表示精度（bfloat16 相对 float16 为 8.00 倍，float16 相对 float32 为 8192.0 倍，与基于尾数位数的预测一致）；其二，批次不变性会在某些张量形状下偶然出现，使实践者只需设置序列长度即可实现零非确定性。随后，我们对模型 top-1 / top-2 逻辑值（logits）的间隔施加铰链惩罚（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文实证刻画了零温度贪心解码中由批次共享引起的词元翻转扰动，发现其幅度精确对应于尾数精度且特定张量形状下可偶然获得批次不变性，进而提出对 top-1/top-2 逻辑值间隔施加铰链惩罚的微调正则化方法，从训练层面降低解码对批次扰动的敏感性而无需牺牲推理吞吐量。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically characterizes batch-induced token flips in greedy decoding—showing the perturbation scales exactly with mantissa precision and batch invariance occurs accidentally at certain tensor shapes—and proposes fine-tuning with hinge regularization on the top-1/top-2 logit margin to reduce decoding nondeterminism at training time without sacrificing inference throughput.
